note: Written only by scripts/board-lessons.py. Our own cartridges, built from lessons/ and measured on our console; a comparison with a commercial game carries counts only.

lessons.title: A jump that feels like Mario's
lessons.description: A cartridge of our own whose square walks and jumps with the numbers read off Super Mario Bros., measured beside it, with its program.

lessons.title: Rooms that slide in the way Zelda's do
lessons.description: A cartridge of our own that holds the picture still and brings the next room in when the square walks out of one, sliding across and writing over itself up and down, the way The Legend of Zelda was measured doing it, measured beside it, with its program.

lessons.title: One byte chooses the screen, the way Mario's does
lessons.description: A cartridge of our own with a title, play and a pause chosen by one byte through a jump table after a call, the way Super Mario Bros. was measured choosing its screens, and what our own autopsy says of it.

lessons.title: A picture that scrolls the way Mario's does
lessons.description: A cartridge of our own whose picture follows the square and builds the land ahead in strips, the way Super Mario Bros. was measured doing it, measured beside it, with its program.

lessons.title: A stomp and a hit, told apart the way Mario does
lessons.description: A cartridge of our own where touching a walker from above, falling, flattens it and bounces, and any other touch is a hit, the way Super Mario Bros. was measured telling them apart, measured beside it, with its program.
